name: bambulab-metrics-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Bambu Lab 3D printers (local LAN or Bambu Cloud). Exposes /metrics for Prometheus, /health, /ready, a status page at / and a printer connection page at /auth. Quick setup: 1) Set Secret Key (generate once, for example: openssl rand -hex 32) and keep it. 2) Start the container and open WebUI, then Printer connection (/auth). 3) Choose Local (printer IP, serial, LAN access code) or Bambu Cloud (email and verification code). The exporter connects right away and keeps the settings across restarts. All printer and login fields below are optional; use them only if you prefer configuring with variables. Settings saved on the /auth page take precedence over them. The /auth page has no login of its own; keep the port on a trusted network.

paths.name: Config Dir
paths.description: Stores the encrypted /auth page settings and cloud credentials.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the web UI and /metrics.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Encrypts the settings and cloud login saved by the /auth page so they survive restarts. Generate once (openssl rand -hex 32) and keep it; changing it means connecting again.

variables.name: Transport
variables.description: Optional. local_mqtt (LAN) or cloud_mqtt (Bambu Cloud). Ignored once a connection is saved on the /auth page.

variables.name: Printer Serial
variables.description: Optional. Printer serial number; leave empty to set it on the /auth page.

variables.name: Local Host/IP
variables.description: Optional, local_mqtt only. Printer IP or hostname; leave empty to set it on the /auth page.

variables.name: Local Access Code
variables.description: Optional, local_mqtt only. LAN access code from the printer (Settings, Network); leave empty to set it on the /auth page.

variables.name: Local MQTT Port
variables.description: local_mqtt only. Keep 8883.

variables.name: Local MQTT Username
variables.description: local_mqtt only. Keep bblp.

variables.name: Cloud Email
variables.description: Optional, cloud_mqtt only. For the env-variable login flow: the container emails a verification code to this address. Not needed when you log in on the /auth page.

variables.name: Cloud One-Time Code
variables.description: Optional, cloud_mqtt only. Legacy: the emailed verification code for the env-variable flow; remove it after login. Logging in on the /auth page is easier.

variables.name: Cloud User ID
variables.description: Optional, cloud_mqtt only. Only for manually obtained tokens; leave empty.

variables.name: Cloud Access Token
variables.description: Optional, cloud_mqtt only. Only for manually obtained tokens; leave empty.

variables.name: Cloud Refresh Token
variables.description: Optional, cloud_mqtt only. Only for manually obtained tokens; leave empty.

variables.name: Cloud MQTT Host
variables.description: cloud_mqtt only. Bambu Cloud MQTT broker; keep the default unless your account uses another region.

variables.name: Cloud MQTT Port
variables.description: cloud_mqtt only. Keep 8883.

variables.name: Printer Name Label
variables.description: Optional. printer_name label on all metrics; leave empty to use the printer name from the printer or Bambu Cloud.

variables.name: Request Snapshots
variables.description: true: ask the printer for a full status report every poll (read-only). false: only listen to updates the printer sends on its own.

variables.name: Polling Interval
variables.description: Seconds between polls.

variables.name: Request Timeout
variables.description: Seconds to wait for a printer report each poll.

variables.name: Auth Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Extra host names allowed for the /auth page, comma separated (for example a reverse-proxy name). IP addresses and local names are always allowed.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log verbosity.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the exporter runs as (Unraid: 99).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the exporter runs as (Unraid: 100).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask.

variables.name: Listen Host
variables.description: HTTP bind address inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: Listen Port
variables.description: HTTP port inside the container. Keep 9109; to use another port on the server, change Web UI Port instead.

variables.name: Config Dir Env
variables.description: Config path inside the container; must match the Config Dir container path.

variables.name: Credentials File
variables.description: Encrypted credentials file name in the config directory.
